conventions.name: production-package-scaffolding
conventions.description: Every production package under packages/ follows the HoBo package layout: a package.json + tsconfig.json alongside src/ (implementation), test/ (tests), contracts/ (PACT boundary contracts), and data-models/ (protobuf + CUE constrained types). See AGENTS.md.

conventions.name: nested-package-scaffolding
conventions.description: Packages nested under a category container (runtimes/, providers/, iac/, adapters/, connectors/, packs/) follow the same HoBo package layout as top-level packages.

conventions.name: cd-source-folder-readme
conventions.description: Every @hobo/cd source folder carries a README.md with a Runbook section (plan 0024 §7.8 and §7.11; ADR-0181). docs/runbooks/cd/ is assembled from those sections. adapters/ is a flat folder of single-file adapters owned per file and documented in packages/cd/README.md.
